result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Infer the schema of a bound CSV or database contract asset

USAGE:
    packata infer <SOURCE> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    packata datapackage.json --asset customers

ARGUMENTS:
    <SOURCE>    ODCS or Data Package v2 contract containing the bound asset

OPTIONS:
                                     DEFAULT                                    
    -h, --help                                  Prints help information         
        --asset <ID>                            Identifier of the bound asset to
                                                infer                           
        --output <PATH>                         Write an enriched copy without  
                                                modifying the source document   
        --write                                 Atomically update the source    
                                                document in place               
        --maximum-records <COUNT>    1000       Maximum number of CSV records to
                                                sample; ignored for databases   
        --maximum-bytes <COUNT>                 Optional maximum CSV bytes to   
                                                sample; ignored for databases   
        --culture <NAME>                        Culture used for inferred CSV   
                                                values; ignored for databases   
        --header <MODE>              auto       CSV header mode: auto, present, 
                                                or absent; ignored for databases
        --no-dialect-inference                  Use contract dialect hints      
                                                without inferring the CSV       
                                                dialect

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Preview a bounded sample of a bound contract asset

USAGE:
    packata data preview <SOURCE> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    packata data preview contract.yaml --asset customers --limit 20

ARGUMENTS:
    <SOURCE>    ODCS YAML or Data Package v2 JSON/YAML contract document

OPTIONS:
                             DEFAULT                                            
    -h, --help                          Prints help information                 
        --asset <ID>                    Required canonical asset identifier to  
                                        preview                                 
        --limit <COUNT>      20         Maximum data rows to return, excluding  
                                        headers. Must be positive               
        --columns <NAMES>               Comma-separated exact field names in the
                                        requested order; default is all fields  
        --output <FORMAT>    table      Output representation: table, json, or  
                                        csv. Use shell redirection to save it
